description: Verify that TCP moves from TIME-WAIT to CLOSED after a 2*MSL timeout, with TIME-WAIT reached through FIN-WAIT-2 (RFC 793 §3.2 p23 Terminology)
approach:
[Objective]
TIME-WAIT exists to absorb stray late segments. After 2*MSL the binding is released. Reached via FW2 path (active-close + peer-FIN sequence). Linux DUT uses kTimeWaitFullWait=72 s.

[Scenario — chronological]
1. driveTcpToTimeWaitFw2 prelude → DUT in TIME-WAIT.
2. Wait 2*MSL.
3. Tester → DUT: probe segment.
4. Observation: DUT → Tester: RST (CLOSED-state response)   ← key check

[Pass condition]
DUT replies RST to the post-2MSL probe (state moved to CLOSED).

[Fail condition]
• Fail_no_handshake_ack / Fail_no_close_fin / Fail_no_tester_fin_ack — prelude broken
• Fail_no_replay_rst — no RST after 2*MSL (still in TIME-WAIT)

verdicts.Pass: DUT moved TIME-WAIT → CLOSED after 2*MSL (FW2) — normal
verdicts.Fail_no_tester_fin_ack: No DUT ACK to tester FIN
verdicts.Fail_no_replay_rst: No DUT RST after 2*MSL post TIME-WAIT
